summary:
Plan of w245 (supervision#r222@0.29) written to plan.md.
Red today: the Given at features/supervision.feature:2086 has no step definition, and Merge.merge refuses on the first failing run with no second run.
Change: Merge.merge collects the FAILED node ids of both pre-merge runs and runs each distinct one once more, alone, through the work-item command with the node id appended. A passing second run counts as passing (r219, r222). A run that names no scenario is refused as today. The second run is logged under its own event, not suite.
Fixture: a new Given in supervision_tests_steps.py writes a pytest-bdd fixture of its own. In it, 'it closes' @r1 fails unless run by its own node id. THING_FEATURE is not changed, so the scenarios that use it keep passing.
The file set drops supervision_world.py and supervision_given.py from the researcher's set.
No existing test breaks (r4 stub rows, [tests] scenario, r43 check_counted, pytest_given_work_item checked).
